_doc: Offline golden set for the People-structure lines of the {company} block (agents/company.py render_structure). Deterministic: no model is called. Each case is an org structure, the participant's own team ids, the teams present in the meeting, and what the rendered block must and must not say. tests/test_org_structure.py runs it through every default prompt that renders {company}.

departments.name: Engineering

departments.description: Finds, closes and keeps customers. Owns pricing and contracts.

departments.description: Owns data protection reviews, vendor risk and incident response.

teams.description: Owns CI, deploys, the database and on-call for production incidents.

teams.description: Owns invoices, Stripe, payment failures and EU VAT.

teams.name: AppSec
